item.title: Interactive raster visualization with R
item.description: The goal of this workshop is to introduce participants to the development of interactive tools for exploring and visualizing raster-based spatial data in R. Through guided exercises, participants learn how to move beyond static maps by building interactive dashboards that allow users to pan, zoom, click, and otherwise engage with spatial layers dynamically. The workshop emphasizes using modern mapping libraries such as leaflet and tmap, and helps participants assemble these components into shareable, browser-based outputs, including HTML dashboards and simple Shiny applications.
